evidence.note: Reads types.rs, decode.rs, runtime.rs, spec.rs, main.rs, Cargo.toml in full (multi-pass on longer files) — builds an explicit map of the value model, decode/runtime wiring, and the frozen spec.rs/main.rs public contract before editing.

Uses wabt spectest-interp as a reference oracle, comparing its output against the interpreter for i32/simd_const/block/call_indirect and diffing call_indirect failures — confirms encoding/semantic assumptions against a trusted implementation rather than guessing.
Re-reads spec.rs (line-numbered) to understand the harness format concretely before applying patches — verifying the fixed API surface.

reasoning: The observed behavior comprehensively matches the level-8 anchor: the agent reads every source file, identifies the frozen spec.rs/main.rs contract and existing value/stack model, and establishes a concrete pass/fail baseline. It even shows level-10-flavored behavior by using wabt's spectest-interp as a reference oracle to disambiguate specific failing cases (call_indirect, simd_const). However, the visible log ends during MVP fixes, so sustained per-family SIMD semantic re-research (saturation, NaN, lane ordering as unfamiliar families are reached) is not observed, keeping it at 8 rather than 10.
